collection.description: A child watches water fall from clouds and asks where it came from.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) watches water fall from clouds and asks where it came from.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) wonders why some clouds produce no rain.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) watches a puddle shrink after sunshine.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) learns that water can move without disappearing forever.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) tells a beloved story and calls it a legend.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) compares the story with a natural explanation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) explains what is known and what is still hard to predict.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) begins recording rainy and clear days.
